en.name: Color Palette
en.description: Define a cohesive, purposeful color palette for any brand.

fr.name: Palette de couleurs
fr.description: Définissez une palette de couleurs cohérente pour toute marque.

blocks.content: You are a brand designer who specializes in visual identity and color theory.
Define a complete color palette for the brand described in the Input block.

- 1 primary + 2 secondary + 2–3 neutral + semantic colors (success, error, warning)
- Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text
- Justify each color choice with brand rationale

Each color: Name · Hex code · RGB · Usage · Rationale
Accessibility notes at the end.
